title: Keto Gooey Croatian Meat Skewers
description: A romantic Croatian dish featuring chimichurri sauce and spherified meat, perfect for a keto diet.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together ground beef, garlic powder, and paprika.
Thread the meat mixture onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, or until cooked to an internal temperature of 160 degrees Fahrenheit.
While the skewers are cooking, prepare the spherification bath by mixing water and sodium alginate in a large bowl.
Once the skewers are cooked, remove them from the grill and carefully place them into the spherification bath.
Let the skewers sit in the bath for 30 seconds to 1 minute, or until they are fully coated in the sodium alginate mixture.
Remove the skewers from the bath and place them on a plate or serving dish.
Drizzle the chimichurri sauce over the skewers and serve immediately.
